lines.speaker: host
lines.text: An envelope slides under your door.

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: Inside is a bill, and the name at the top is yours.

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: Amount due, for the last hour of sunlight on Earth: thirty *trillion* dollars.

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: You laugh. Then you check the sum.

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: Take all the sunlight that lands on this planet in one *hour.*

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: Price it like the electricity in your wall.

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: Thirty trillion. About what the whole United States earns in a year.

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: Every *four* hours, the Sun delivers the value of everything the entire world earns in a year.

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: And then it does it again.

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: In under ninety minutes, the Earth soaks up more energy than every city, car and factory will use this year.
